[goal:evidence]After 6 rounds of autonomous experimentation testing 31+ C++ candidates against the RoConstruct roc check tool, the RenderScene function (2008-06, 0x007AB0A0) score remains at 35%, unchanged from the baseline established by the "std::exception instead of std::runtime_error" historical candidate. Round 2 (r2_*): All 9 candidates compilation failures (0%). Round 3 (r3_*): 10 noinline helper candidates - best 33%. Round 4 (r4_*): 10 structural reorder candidates - best 34% (camera reorder). Round 5 (r5_*): 3 candidates - matrix size 0x88, background reorder, pose static order - best 35% (no improvement). Round 6 (r6_*): 3 candidates - forward declarations, __thiscall macro, alignment - all compilation failures (0%). Total candidates: 31 across 6 rounds. Compilation failures: At least 14 candidates failed to compile (0% score). Best-performing single change: std::exception vs std::runtime_error (established 35% baseline in earlier historical work, confirmed still best). All other incremental C++ changes (stack layout, variable reordering, VCall adjustments, Ogre header modifications, __thiscall variants, exception handling tweaks) either maintained 35% or produced worse scores. Most important remaining mismatches: Function prologue/SEH frame layout (original has hand-written `push -1`/`sub esp, 0x310` prologue), exact VCall call sequencing and argument ordering, Ogre object lifetime/destructor call patterns, and control flow structure of the rendering loop - these mismatches appear to require binary-lifting analysis (Remill/McSema) rather than C++ source edits. Verified Remill/LLVM findings: Tools unavailable due to missing LLVM dev files and XED; McSema/Remill binary-lifting attempts were previously attempted and unsuccessful. Location of best C++ source: src/2008-06/007ab0a0.cpp (35% score, the std::exception candidate). Commands used: roc.cmd check 2008-06 007ab0a0 --file <path> --context 0 for each candidate. No further incremental C++ improvements beyond 35% found with MSVC 2008 toolchain.
